lessons.text: Process an invoice by first locating the email in /mail, downloading the PDF to the workspace, then querying ERP read-only endpoints GET /vendors?q=<vendor-name> and GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number> before any write.

Send AP confirmation by opening /mail/compose, filling the To field from the company directory, Subject, and Message fields, clicking Send, then verifying with GET /bills?... endpoint that exactly one bill exists.
An existing bill for the same vendor/invoice number may have status Paid; do not create a duplicate—skip creation and use the existing bill id in the confirmation message.

The ERP read-only endpoint /vendors?q=<query> returns vendor records with fields such as id, name, and email_domain; matching the invoice sender's email domain to email_domain is a reliable way to confirm the vendor.
Company documentation accessible via read_company_doc includes sop_invoice_processing, policy_finance_controls, and directory; the directory stores AP lead email addresses for confirmations.
